BASELINE_EQUIVALENT: absolute PR-AUC delta <= 0.01 and interval includes zero
BASELINE_OUTPERFORMS_CD: PR-AUC delta < -0.01 and grouped-bootstrap upper 95% bound < 0
BLOCKED_DATA_NOT_MATERIALIZED: public trajectory bytes unavailable in execution environment
CD_ADDS_HELDOUT_SIGNAL: simple+CD PR-AUC delta > 0.02, grouped-bootstrap lower 95% bound > 0, and ROC-AUC delta >= -0.005
overall_rule: At least two of four prefixes must share a directional disposition; otherwise NO_RELIABLE_SIGNAL.
